facts.text: Audrey expressed that the dogs bring joy into her life.

evidence.quote: I love them for that. They really do bring so much joy into my life.

facts.text: Andrew mentioned that the dogs bring a lot into their lives and shared a photo of flowers on a balcony.

evidence.quote: They really do bring so much into our lives - it's amazing to watch them interact. Here's something I've been taking care of lately. Look at those flowers!

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that taking care of plants relaxes her and brings her peace, and she has a small garden.

evidence.quote: Nice! Taking care of something like this relaxes me and brings me peace too. I personally have a small garden as well ya know.

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that her veggie patch is coming along and that it feels accomplishing to see the plants grow.

evidence.quote: It's going great! The flowers are looking great and my veggie patch is coming along. It's so fun to see them grow! Really feels accomplishing.
